display.purpose: Large brand statements and page-level moments.

body.purpose: Supporting copy and dense interface information.

label.purpose: Compact set labels, metadata, and counts.

components.name: Primary Button
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { min-height: 50px; padding: 0 16px; border: 1px solid #101B2D; border-radius: 8px; background: #101B2D; color: #FCFBF9; font-family: Sora, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: .02em; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 150ms cubic-bezier(.2,0,0,1), filter 150ms cubic-bezier(.2,0,0,1), transform 150ms cubic-bezier(.2,0,0,1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { filter: brightness(1.1); transform: translateY(-1px); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #2979FF; outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: translateY(0); }

components.name: Discovery Button
components.description: A bright blue action for discovery and utility direction.
components.css: .ds-btn-discovery { min-height: 50px; padding: 0 16px; border: 1px solid #2979FF; border-radius: 8px; background: #2979FF; color: #FFFFFF; font-family: Sora, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: .02em; cursor: pointer; transition: filter 150ms cubic-bezier(.2,0,0,1), transform 150ms cubic-bezier(.2,0,0,1); } .ds-btn-discovery:hover { filter: brightness(1.1); transform: translateY(-1px); } .ds-btn-discovery:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #C7F33B; outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-btn-discovery:active { transform: translateY(0); }

components.name: Search Field
components.description: A quiet paper-white input with an unmistakable discovery focus state.
components.html: <label class="ds-search-label">CARD SEARCH<input class="ds-input" placeholder="Search cards, sets, or collectors" /></label>
components.css: .ds-search-label { display: grid; gap: 7px; color: #101B2D; font-family: Sora, sans-serif; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: .08em; } .ds-input { min-height: 50px; padding: 0 14px; border: 1px solid #B0ADB2; border-radius: 8px; background: #FFFFFF; color: #111111; font: 400 14px/1.5 Manrope, sans-serif; transition: border-color 150ms cubic-bezier(.2,0,0,1), box-shadow 150ms cubic-bezier(.2,0,0,1); } .ds-input::placeholder { color: #626067; } .ds-input:hover { border-color: #2979FF; } .ds-input:focus-visible { border-color: #2979FF; outline: 3px solid #2979FF; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Collection Card
components.description: A flat default container that lifts only when interactive.
components.css: .ds-card { padding: 20px; border: 1px solid #B0ADB2; border-radius: 12px; background: #FCFBF9; color: #111111; transition: border-color 150ms cubic-bezier(.2,0,0,1), box-shadow 150ms cubic-bezier(.2,0,0,1), transform 150ms cubic-bezier(.2,0,0,1); } .ds-card:hover { border-color: #2979FF; box-shadow: 0 4px 12px rgba(17,17,17,.16); transform: translateY(-1px); } .ds-card span { color: #2979FF; font: 600 11px/1 Sora, sans-serif; letter-spacing: .08em; } .ds-card h3 { margin: 12px 0 6px; color: #101B2D; font: 700 22px/1 Sora, sans-serif; } .ds-card p { margin: 0; color: #55515A; font: 400 14px/1.5 Manrope, sans-serif; }

components.name: Brand Navigation
components.description: A navy identity bar with white reversed branding and blue active direction.
components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 20px; min-height: 64px; padding: 0 20px; background: #101B2D; color: #FCFBF9; } .ds-nav strong { margin-right: auto; font: 700 18px/1 Sora, sans-serif; } .ds-nav a { color: #FCFBF9; font: 600 11px/1 Sora, sans-serif; letter-spacing: .08em; text-decoration: none; } .ds-nav a:hover, .ds-nav a.is-active { color: #2979FF; } .ds-nav a:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #C7F33B; outline-offset: 3px; }

narrative.overview:
Next Pull is precise, recognisable, and alive with the anticipation of finding the next card. The system leads with deep navy and quiet paper surfaces, using a bright blue for small moments of direction and a sharp lime for rare, deliberate emphasis. It should feel more like a clear trading signal than a decorative game interface.

The visual voice is bold but not loud: large Sora statements establish confidence, while Manrope keeps product information calm and highly legible. The supplied card-and-spark signature is the brand's most distinctive asset; UI should create the quiet, solid fields that allow it to read cleanly.
keyCharacteristics: Direct, compact, and collector-first rather than ornamental.
Bright blue for wayfinding; lime for sparing signature emphasis.
Crisp geometry, solid surfaces, and controlled state motion.

rules.name: The Navy Leads Rule
rules.body: Start with navy, paper, and ink. Add blue for direction and lime only for emphasis; the logo itself is always one solid color.

rules.name: The Two Families Rule
rules.body: Do not recreate the supplied Next Pull wordmark with Sora or Manrope. Use the supplied outlined logo paths; these families support the signature, not substitute for it.

rules.name: The Quiet Surface Rule
rules.body: Do not add gradients, shadows, or busy texture to a logo field. Surface gradients are allowed only as documented brand fields: deep navy to deep ink, navy to electric blue, or electric blue back to navy.

dos: Do lead a screen with Signal Navy, Collector Paper, and Reading Ink before introducing accents.
Do use Sora Bold/Semibold for statements and headings, and Manrope Regular for supporting UI copy.
Do keep the supplied signature's clear space, proportions, and single-solid-color treatment intact.
Do export supplied artwork as SVG for scalable uses and transparent PNG for quick placement.
Do respect reduced-motion preferences and pair status colors with text, icons, or other non-color cues.
donts: Don't retype, stretch, rotate, shadow, gradient-fill, or otherwise alter the Next Pull wordmark.
Don't let blue or lime dominate a page that should be navy-led.
Don't use a busy, textured, or gradient field behind the signature.
Don't turn every compact control into a pill or use visual decoration in place of product hierarchy.
